description:
FILED s526w2 (Opus, resumed s528 2026-10-25) as the residue of #3863 (the subscript is SCALAR context -- fixed for slices and calls; the array-variable spelling is a different emission site).  PRE-EXISTING (main 31cd8c02).

    my @a = (1,2); my %h = (2 => "two"); print $h{@a}, "|", "$h{@a}", "\n";
  perl 5.40.3: two|two      PCL: |
  emission: (p-print (p-string-concat (p-gethash %h @a)))  -- the array variable is emitted bare although its node is now annotated SCALAR_CTX.
  Probe scratch/s526w2/pslk4.pl.  The generator path for an array variable in a subscript slot should consult the node context (the way `my $n = @a` counts), and the interpolation path's subscript compile likewise.  Rows: none known on the board.


=== DONE (s530a, 2026-10-31) ===
MECHANISM: #3863 made the subscript SCALAR context in PExpr's child_context, but an ARRAY operand is emitted bare whatever its node context (`my $n = @a` counts only because p-my-= numifies a vector); p-aref numifies a vector index too (so `$a[@a]` was already right), p-gethash stringifies it.
FIX (Pl/ExprToCL.pm, ONE place): _hash_key_form -- the one hash-key rule the read, the store, the interpolation and `->{}` share -- wraps an array operand (_is_array_expr_node: `@a`, `@$r`, `@{...}`) in `(p-scalar ...)`, the `scalar(@a)` spelling; _elem_container_key (exists / delete / pos / tie / tied) now forms a hash ELEMENT key through _hash_key_form too, which also makes a multi-key `exists $h{$x,$y}` join with $; (it emitted the progn).  Generation v2-9000.
PROBES: scratch/s530a/pr/c2.pl + c3.pl (read, interpolated, ->{}, @$r, @{$r}, store, empty array, exists / delete / pos, `$c{@a}++`, `$t{@k} = 1`, multi-key exists) identical to perl 5.40.3.
GUARD: Pl/t/misc-fixes-01.t row 30 (the #3865 row beside #3863's), inverse-verified.  corpus-diff vs 0fb05a79 IDENTICAL over 111 files (no such key in the corpus).
NOT FIXED, FILED #4062: `local $h{@a}` -- the local element forms are lowered by the v1 text seam, which never reaches _hash_key_form.
subject: SILENT WRONG: a bare ARRAY variable as an element subscript, `$h{@a}` / `$a[@a]` (and interpolated "$h{@a}"), passes the array itself -- `(p-gethash %h @a)` -- where perl keys on the COUNT
